title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: The M&A Class Action Firm Investigates the Merger of Sandy Spring Bancorp, Inc. – SASR
description: Monteverde & Associates PC is investigating the proposed merger between Sandy Spring Bancorp, Inc. (SASR) and Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp. Under the terms, Sandy Spring shareholders will receive 0.900 Atlantic Union shares and cash for fractional shares.

title: Atlantic Union Bankshares To Acquire Sandy Spring Bancorp For $1.6B, Creating $39B Regional Banking Powerhouse
description: Atlantic Union Bankshares announced the acquisition of Sandy Spring Bancorp for $1.6 billion, creating a regional banking powerhouse with $39.2 billion in assets.

title: $HAREHOLDER INVESTIGATION: The M&A Class Action Firm Continues to Investigate the Mergers of BRKH, AUB, CTV and VBFC
description: The M&A Class Action Firm is investigating the proposed mergers of BurTech Acquisition Corp. (BRKH), Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp. (AUB), Innovid Corp. (CTV), and Village Bank and Trust Financial Corp. (VBFC) to determine if the terms are fair to shareholders.
